paragraphs: We are a publicly traded, self-managed equity REIT that focuses on the ownership, management, and repositioning of high-quality retail and mixed-use properties located primarily in what we believe to be faster growing, business-friendly markets exhibiting accommodative business tax policies, outsized relative job and population growth, and where retail demand exceeds supply. We have pursued our investment strategy by investing primarily through fee simple ownership of our properties, commercial loans and preferred equity.

As of December 31, 2025, we own and manage, sometimes utilizing third-party property management companies, 21 commercial real estate properties in 7 states in the United States, comprising 5.5 million square feet of gross leasable space. In addition to our income property portfolio, as of December 31, 2025, our business included the following:

Management Services: A fee-based management business that is engaged in managing PINE, as well as: (i) a portfolio of assets pursuant to the Portfolio Management Agreement (hereinafter defined) and (ii) Subsurface Interests (hereinafter defined) pursuant to the Subsurface Management Agreement (hereinafter defined), as further described in Note 5, "Management Services Business" in the notes to the consolidated financial statements in Item 8.
Commercial Loans and Investments: A portfolio of four commercial loan investments and two preferred equity investments which are classified as commercial loan investments.

Real Estate Operations: There were no significant transactions within the Company's real estate operations during the year ended December 31, 2025. During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company sold its remaining mitigation credits. These credits were produced by the Company's formerly owned mitigation bank. During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company sold its portfolio of subsurface mineral interests associated with approximately 352,000 surface acres in 19 counties in the State of Florida ("Subsurface Interests"), as further described in Note 6, "Real Estate Operations". As part of the Subsurface Interests sale, the Company entered into a management agreement with the buyer to provide ongoing management services (the "Subsurface Management Agreement").

Our business also includes our investment in PINE. As of December 31, 2025, the fair value of our investment totaled $41.3 million, or 15.4% of PINE's outstanding common equity, including the units of limited partnership interest ("OP Units") we hold in Alpine Income Property OP, LP (the "PINE Operating Partnership"), which are redeemable for cash, based upon the value of an equivalent number of shares of PINE common stock at the time of the redemption, or shares of PINE common stock on a one-for-one basis, at PINE's election. Our investment in PINE generates investment income through the dividends distributed by PINE. In addition to the dividends we receive from PINE, our investment in PINE may benefit from any appreciation in PINE's stock price, although no assurances can be provided that such appreciation will occur, the amount by which our investment will increase in value, or the timing thereof. Any dividends received from PINE are included in investment and other income on the accompanying consolidated statements of operations.

headings: We are subject to risks related to the ownership of commercial real estate that could affect the performance and value of our properties.

Global trade disruption, significant introductions of trade barriers and bilateral trade frictions, together with any future downturns in the global economy resulting therefrom, could adversely affect our performance.
Our business is dependent upon our tenants successfully operating their businesses, and their failure to do so could materially and adversely affect us.
Competition that traditional retail tenants face from e-commerce retail sales, or the integration of brick and mortar stores with e-commerce retail operators, could adversely affect our business.

We operate in a highly competitive market for the acquisition of income properties and more established entities or other investors may be able to compete more effectively for acquisition opportunities than we can.
The loss of revenues from our income property portfolio or certain tenants would adversely impact our results of operations and cash flows.
Certain provisions of the Company's leases may be unenforceable.
We may not be able to dispose of properties we target for sale to recycle our capital.
Management of and Investment in PINE
An internalization of PINE's management functions could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We may be unable to successfully operate PINE's business.
Declines in the market values of our investment in PINE may adversely affect periodic reported results.

A part of our investment strategy is focused on investing in commercial loans and investments which may involve credit risk or the risk that our borrowers will fail to pay scheduled contractual payments to us when due.
Our commercial loans and investments segment is also exposed to risks associated with real estate investments generally.
Our origination or acquisition of construction loans exposes us to an increased risk of loss.
Our investments in construction loans require us to make estimates about the fair value of land improvements that may be challenged by the Internal Revenue Service ("IRS").
Because of competition, we may not be able to originate or acquire commercial loans or similar financings at all or at favorable yields.
Debt and preferred equity investments could cause us to incur expenses, which could adversely affect our results of operations.
The mezzanine loan assets that we may acquire will involve greater risks of loss than senior loans secured by income-producing properties.

We invest in fixed-rate loan investments, and an increase in interest rates may adversely affect the value of these investments, which could adversely impact our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
We may suffer losses when a borrower defaults on a loan and the value of the underlying collateral is less than the amount due.
We could fail to continue to qualify as a REIT if the IRS successfully challenges our treatment of any mezzanine loans in which we invest.
paragraphs: Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our securities speculative or risky. This summary does not address all of the risks that we face. Additional discussion of the risks summarized in this risk factor summary, and other risks that we face, can be found below under the heading "Risk Factors" and should be carefully considered, together with other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and our other filings with the SEC, before making an investment decision regarding our securities.
● We are subject to risks related to the ownership of commercial real estate that could affect the performance and value of our properties.

● Adverse changes in U.S., global and local regions or markets that impact our tenants' businesses may materially and adversely affect us generally and the ability of our tenants to make rental payments to us pursuant to our leases.
● Our business is dependent upon our tenants successfully operating their businesses, and their failure to do so could materially and adversely affect us.
● The loss of revenues from our income property or commercial loans and investments portfolios or certain tenants or borrowers would adversely impact our results of operations and cash flows.

● Retail properties, particularly those with multiple tenants, often depend on the presence of and successful operation of an anchor tenant or tenants and the failure of such tenant's business or the loss of the anchor tenant(s) could adversely affect the overall success of our property and thereby could adversely impact our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家公開上市、自營管理的權益型不動產投資信託基金（REIT），專注於擁有、管理及重新定位高品質的零售及混合用途不動產，這些不動產主要位於我們認為成長較快、營商環境友善的市場，這些市場具有寬鬆的營業稅政策、相對過度的就業與人口成長，且零售需求大於供給。本公司透過主要以費用簡單所有權方式投資不動產、商業貸款及優先股，來執行其投資策略。
截至2025年12月31日，本公司擁有並管理（有時會利用第三方不動產管理公司）美國7個州內21處商業不動產，總計550萬平方英呎的總可出租面積。除了我們的收入性不動產投資組合外，截至2025年12月31日，本公司業務包含以下內容：
管理服務：一家以費用為基礎的管理業務，專門管理PINE，以及：(i) 依據資產管理協議（後述）管理的資產組合，以及 (ii) 依據地下權益管理協議（後述）管理的地下權益（後述），如進一步說明於第5節「管理服務業務」的備註中，於第8項財務報表附註中說明。
商業貸款與投資：包含四筆商業貸款投資及兩筆優先股投資的投資組合，這些投資被歸類為商業貸款投資。

不動產營運：於2025年12月31日財年內，本公司不動產營運未有重大交易。於2024年財年內，本公司出售其剩餘的緩衝信用額。這些信用額由本公司曾擁有之緩衝銀行所產生。於2024年財年內，本公司出售其與約352,000英畝地表面積相關的地下礦物權益（「地下權益」），這些地表面積位於佛羅裏達州19個縣（「地下權益」），如進一步說明於第6節「不動產營運」。作為地下權益出售的一部分，本公司與買方簽訂管理協議，提供持續的管理服務（「地下權益管理協議」）。

本公司之業務亦包含對 PINE 之投資。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司投資之公允價值總計為 41.3 百萬美元，佔 PINE 浮動普通股權益之 15.4%，包含本公司於 Alpine Income Property OP, LP（稱為「PINE 操作合夥」）所持有之有限合夥權益單位（"OP Units"），這些單位可依 PINE 普通股價值，以現金兌換，或依 PINE 之選擇，以一股對一股之方式兌換 PINE 普通股。本公司對 PINE 之投資透過 PINE 分配之股息產生投資收入。除自 PINE 收到之股息外，本公司對 PINE 之投資亦可能因 PINE 股價上漲而受益，不過無法保證此等上漲將發生，亦無法保證本公司投資價值增加之金額或時間。自 PINE 收到之股息已包含於隨附之合併營運損益表之投資及其他收入項目中。

本公司為一公開上市、自營管理之權益 REIT，專注於擁有、管理及重新定位高品質零售及混合用途不動產，這些不動產主要位於本公司認為較快速成長、營商友好的市場，這些市場具有寬鬆的營業稅政策、相對過度的就業與人口成長，且零售需求高於供給。本公司已透過主要以費簡單所有權方式投資不動產、商業貸款及優先股，來執行投資策略。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司擁有並管理（有時透過第三方不動產管理公司）美國 7 個州共 21 項商業不動產，總計 5.5 百萬平方英呎之總可出租面積。除我們的收入不動產投資組合外，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司業務尚包括以下項目：
管理服務：一項以費用為基礎的管理業務，專門管理 PINE，以及：(i) 依 Portfolio Management Agreement（後述）管理一組資產，及 (ii) 依 Subsurface Management Agreement（後述）管理 Subsurface Interests（後述），如進一步說明於第 8 項 "管理服務業務" 之財務明細附註中。
商業貸款與投資：包含四項商業貸款投資及兩項優先股投資之投資組合，歸類為商業貸款投資。

不動產營運：於 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止之會計年度，本公司不動產營運中未有重大交易。於 2024 年 12 月 31 日結止之會計年度，本公司出售其剩餘之緩衝信用額。這些信用額由本公司曾擁有之緩衝銀行所產生。於 2024 年 12 月 31 日結止之會計年度，本公司出售其與佛羅裏達州 19 個縣約 352,000 平方英呎地表面積相關之_subsurface mineral interests（後述）投資組合（"Subsurface Interests"），如進一步說明於第 6 項 "不動產營運" 之財務明細附註中。作為 Subsurface Interests 售出之一環，本公司與買方簽訂管理契約，提供持續管理服務（"Subsurface Management Agreement"）。

本公司業務亦包括對 PINE 之投資。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司投資之公允價值為 41.3 百萬美元，佔 PINE 浮動普通股之 15.4%，包括本公司在 Alpine Income Property OP, LP（"PINE Operating Partnership"）所持有之有限合夥權單位（"OP Units"），這些 OP Units 可以現金兌換，兌換金額依兌換時等數量之 PINE 普通股價值，或由 PINE 選擇以一股對一股方式兌換 PINE 普通股。本公司對 PINE 之投資透過 PINE 分配之股息產生投資收入。除本公司自 PINE 所獲之股息外，本公司對 PINE 之投資亦可能因 PINE 股價上漲而受益，不過無法保證此上漲會發生，或投資價值增加之金額或時間。任何自 PINE 所獲之股息
均計入附屬財務明細表之營運收入之投資及其他收入中。
本公司營運於四大主要業務分部：收入性質不動產、管理服務、商業貸款與投資，以及不動產營運。
截至2020年12月31日，本公司已完成若干內部重整交易，以開始符合美國聯邦所得稅法規作為REIT（不動產投資信託）資格與稅務要求，自2020年12月31日結算之課稅年度起生效。有關本公司REIT轉型及相關交易資訊，請參閱第1項「業務」。2021年1月29日，為配合REIT轉型，本公司完成合併交易，以重新註冊為馬裏蘭州公司，並促進其持續符合REIT要求。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
收入性質的不動產營運
本公司面臨與商業不動產所有權相關的風險，這些風險可能影響我們的不動產表現與價值。
全球貿易中斷、重大貿易壁壘的引入以及雙邊貿易摩擦，加上由此可能引發的全球經濟下行，可能會對我們的表現產生不利影響。
本公司業務依賴於租戶成功營運其業務，若租戶未能做到，可能會對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
傳統零售租戶面臨來自電商零售銷售的競爭，或實體商店與電商零售業者整合，可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
本公司所處的收入性質不動產收購市場高度競爭，更為成熟的企業或其他投資者可能比我們更能有效競爭收購機會。
來自我們收入性質不動產投資組合或特定租戶的收入減少，可能會對我們的營運成果與現金流產生不利影響。
本公司租賃條款中某些條款可能無法執行。
我們可能無法處分目標用以出售的不動產以循環運用資本。
將 PINE 的管理功能內部化可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們可能無法成功運作 PINE 的業務。
我們對 PINE 的投資價值下跌可能對定期報告的結果造成不利影響。
本公司投資策略的一部分是投資於商業貸款與投資，這些投資可能涉及信用風險或借款人未能按時支付合同規定的款項的風險。
本公司之商業貸款及投資應報告分部亦面臨與一般不動產投資相關之風險。
本公司於發放或取得建設貸款之過程，可能面臨較高之損失風險。
本公司於建設貸款之投資，需對土地改善之公允價值進行估計，此估計可能遭美國國稅局（"IRS"）質疑。
因市場競爭，本公司可能無法發放或取得商業貸款或類似融資，或無法以有利之收益率發放或取得。
債務及優先股投資可能導致本公司產生費用，此費用可能不利於本公司之營運成果。
本公司可能取得之梅沙貸款資產，其損失風險將高於以收入產生性不動產為擔保之優先貸款。
本公司投資於固定利率貸款，利率上漲可能不利於這些投資之價值，此情況可能對本公司之財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生負面影響。
當借款人違約未償還貸款，且擔保之資產價值低於應償金額時，本公司可能遭受損失。
若國稅局成功挑戰我們對所投資之任何過渡貸款之處理方式，本公司可能無法持續符合REIT之資格。
paragraphs: 以下為主要因素之總結，這些因素使投資本公司證券成為具風險或投機性之行為。此總結並未涵蓋我們所面臨的所有風險。有關本風險因素總結中所提及之風險，以及其他我們所面臨之風險之進一步討論，請參閱本年度報告表10-K「風險因素」節，並與本年度報告表10-K及其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）所提交之文件內容一併考量，以作為投資本公司證券之決定依據。
● 我們面臨與商業不動產所有權相關之風險，這些風險可能影響我們之不動產表現與價值。
● 美國、全球或地方地區或市場之不利變動，可能影響我們租戶之業務，進而對我們整體表現及租戶依租賃契約向我們支付租金之能力產生重大且不利之影響。
● 我們之業務依賴租戶成功運作其業務，若租戶未能做到，可能對我們產生重大且不利之影響。
● 若來自我們收入性不動產或商業貸款及投資組合，或特定租戶或借款人之收入減少，將對我們之營運成果與現金流產生不利影響。
● 零售不動產，特別是擁有數個租戶之不動產，往往依賴主要租戶或租戶之存在與成功運作，若主要租戶之業務失敗或失去主要租戶，可能對我們之不動產整體表現產生不利影響，進而對我們之財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生不利影響。
